data.headline: In Re Oracle Corporation Derivative Litigation: Delaware Supreme Court Affirms Chancery Court Decision Not To Impose Fiduciary Duties On An Influential Minority Stockholder
data.summary: On January 21, 2025, the Delaware Supreme Court affirmed the Court of Chancery's decision in In re Oracle Corp. Derivative Lit., finding that a less than 50% stockholder does not owe fiduciary duties...
